'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
***[[2025 Gaza Strip aid distribution killings]]
****[[Israeli forces]] kill at least 74 [[Palestinians]] across the [[Gaza Strip]], including 23 who were attempting to get [[humanitarian aid]]. [https://www.npr.org/2025/07/01/nx-s1-5452994/israel-gaza-hamas-cafe-airstrike-aid (NPR)]
***[[Al-Baqa Cafe airstrike]]
****At least 39 people are killed and dozens of others injured by an airstrike on the al-Baqa [[internet café]] in [[Gaza City]]. Multiple sportspeople and multiple journalists were killed, including [[Ismail Abu Hatab]]. [https://nos.nl/artikel/2573257-in-cafe-al-baqa-waar-tientallen-mensen-werden-gedood-kwam-jong-gaza-samen (NOS)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2025 United States trade war with Canada and Mexico]]
**[[National Economic Council (United States)|National Economic Council]] director [[Kevin Hassett]] announces that the [[United States]] will restart trade talks with [[Canada]] after they cancel their [[Digital Services Tax Act (Canada)|digital services tax]] on American technology firms. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/politics/us-canada-trade-negotiations-dst-scrapped-1.7574146 (CBC)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Telangana chemical factory explosion]]
**Thirty-six people are killed and several others are injured in an [[Telangana chemical factory explosion|chemical factory explosion]] at a [[pharmaceutical manufacturing|pharmaceutical factory]] in [[Sangareddy]], [[Telangana]], [[India]]. [https://apnews.com/article/india-pharmaceutical-factory-fire-telangana-e914c229736d1b2af3d4565d0e227cb1 (AP)]
*[[Wildfire]]s break out in [[Turkey]] resulting in [[İzmir Adnan Menderes Airport]] cancelling or diverting all flights. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/turkey-wildfires-izmir-airport-flight-cancellations-travel-b2779313.html (''The Independent'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[International sanctions against Syria]], [[Syria–United States relations]]
**[[United States president]] [[Donald Trump]] signs an [[List of executive actions by Donald Trump|executive order]] lifting all American sanctions on [[Syria]] that were imposed during the now-[[Fall of the Assad regime|overthrown]] [[Assad family]]'s [[Ba'athist Syria|regime]]. [https://www.whitehouse.gov/fact-sheets/2025/06/fact-sheet-president-donald-j-trump-provides-for-the-revocation-of-syria-sanctions/ (White House)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2022 University of Idaho killings]]
**Bryan Kohberger, the suspect in the 2022 killings of four [[University of Idaho]] students, pleads guilty to all charges, avoiding the death penalty. [https://abcnews.go.com/US/bryan-kohberger-plead-guilty-counts-idaho-college-murders/story?id=123356808 (ABC News)]
*[[2025 Boulder fire attack]]
**The death of an 82-year-old woman who was severely injured in the [[firebombing]] attack earlier this month is announced by leaders of the Boulder Jewish Community Center. [https://apnews.com/article/boulder-attack-death-e6e45ad5a6e6becab9026994c758e09b (AP)]
*[[2025 Kenyan protests]]
**A civilian vendor shot at close range by police during protests over the [[death of Albert Ojwang]] in [[Nairobi]], [[Kenya]], succumbs to his injuries in hospital after being declared [[brain death|brain-dead]], bringing the death toll from nationwide protests in Kenya to 20. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/article/kenyan-civilian-shot-at-close-range-by-police-during-protests-dies/ (CTV News)] [https://www.dw.com/en/kenya-gen-z-protests-see-press-freedom-under-fire/a-73078878 (DW)]
*[[Murder of Louisa Dunne]]
**Ryland Headley, a 92-year-old man, is convicted for the 1967 murder of Louisa Dunne, which is believed to be the [[UK]]'s longest-running cold case ever to be solved. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/home-news/louisa-dunne-ryland-headley-bristol-b2779623.html (''The Independent'')]
*[[Mexican drug war]]
**Twenty bodies, five of them [[Decapitation|decapitated]], are found either hanging from a bridge or inside a van abandoned beneath, near [[Culiacán]], [[Sinaloa]], amid clashes between factions of the [[Sinaloa Cartel]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/jun/30/mexico-sinaloa-cartel-violence (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Law enforcement in Azerbaijan|Police]] in [[Baku]], [[Azerbaijan]], raid the office of the [[Russia]]n [[state media|state-owned]] news agency [[Sputnik (news agency)|Sputnik]], alleging its operations in Azerbaijan are via "illegal financing" after its official accreditation was revoked in February. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-azerbaijan-police-raid-baku-2d900b44bf72bdd92a8a463ed48babfb (AP)]
